title: UI/VFS: OPFS class writes have no quota handling and are fire-and-forget (silent persist failure)
description: packages/authoring-ui/src/vfs/opfs.ts:115-126 WebClassVfs.write() calls createWritable()/write()/close() with no try/catch for QuotaExceededError (unlike projectStore.put which wraps quota into a non-fatal ProjectQuotaError). ClassesPanel.handleScriptChange (:296) fires void vfs.write(...), so an OPFS quota rejection is unhandled and swallowed by the microtask — the class edit silently fails to persist to OPFS while doc.asClasses was already updated synchronously; on Tauri the on-disk classes/ file then diverges from the doc. Fix: wrap write() to detect quota and surface a one-time warning; don't leave void vfs.write(...) unobserved in handleScriptChange. Confidence: confirmed.
